ns2:course.label: Intro to Leadership Studies
ns2:course.description: Study of leadership theories and their application to the development of leadership skills. Students develop a personal philosophy of leadership, prepare a development plan for enhancing leadership skills, and begin a portfolio to record their leadership growth. Explores topics concerning diversity, ethics, and leadership/follower roles.
ns2:course.sectionDegreeAttributes: Social & Beh Sci - Soc Sci course.
